annotations.title: Search Polish businesses abroad / Szukaj polskich firm

description: Search Polish-run businesses outside Poland listed on Sami Swoi (samiswoi.app), for questions like "Polish plumber in London", "Polish shop in Utrecht", "Polish dentist in Oslo", "polska księgowa w Dublinie". Filters: country, city, category (slug or Polish word, see list_categories) and a phrase from the name or kind of business. Returns up to 20 businesses per call (page with offset/next_offset), each with city, category and its samiswoi.app page, plus the total. / Polskie firmy za granicą: kraj, miasto, kategoria, fraza.

category.description: Category slug from list_categories (e.g. "hydraulik", "sklep-spozywczy") or a Polish word ("dentysta", "fryzjer"). / Kategoria.

city.description: City, e.g. "London", "Londyn", "Utrecht". Best together with country. / Miasto.

country.description: Country: ISO code ("GB", "DE", "NL") or name in Polish or English ("Holandia", "Germany"). / Kraj.

offset.description: Skip this many matches; use next_offset.

query.description: Words from the business name or kind, Polish works best ("delikatesy", "mechanik", "Biedronka"). / Fraza.

name: search_companies

browse_url.description: Page on samiswoi.app with the full list.

id.description: Company id (address on samiswoi.app); use with get_company.

managed_by_owner.description: true = the owner runs this profile; false = built from public data, not yet claimed.

url.description: Company page on samiswoi.app (contact details, map).

note.description: Guidance for answering, e.g. when nothing was found.
